title: Vowels of All Substrings
summary: For a given string, calculate the total count of vowels ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') across all its substrings.
statement: For a given string, calculate the total count of vowels ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') across all its substrings. Note that the result might exceed the capacity of a signed 32-bit integer.
constraints: For every substring, count its vowel occurrences and sum those counts.
Return the total, which may exceed 32-bit range.
hints: A vowel contributes once to every substring containing its index.
Count choices of a left endpoint at or before it and a right endpoint at or after it.
There are exactly i+1 left boundaries and n-i right boundaries, so their product counts every containing substring once.
editorial: There are exactly i+1 left boundaries and n-i right boundaries, so their product counts every containing substring once.

tests.explanation: The substrings contribute vowel counts totaling six.
The initial a appears in three substrings, so the total is three.
